propositions: BindingStore identity transition logic (bind, confirm, unbind, numeric-ID re-key, reverse cleanup) must be extracted into a separate BindingLifecycle class while preserving all existing behavior and public facade signatures.
bind_confirm must remain last-writer-wins on forward entries and pop only the single differing old reverse key, with no sweep or ambiguity detection.
Stale reverse entries must be removed only in four permitted cases: bind_confirm rebind, unbind with sweep, numeric-ID re-key, and _retire.
Immutable numeric-ID re-key (step 4 of note_absent_or_rekey) must move issues by swapping both indexes and resetting absence counters, not retiring them.

The note_absent_or_rekey facade method must retain its coordinate role and guard logic while delegating only the re-key mutation to BindingLifecycle, preserving all caller-visible outcomes and return values.
